entry.title: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Nginx. Xint is reporting that it has discovered a collection of five critical vulnerabilities in the NGINX web server.
entry.summary:
Xint is reporting that it has discovered a collection of five critical vulnerabilities in the NGINX web server. The worst flaw, it says, would allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands on an affected nginx server with HTTP/2 enabled . The company also reports a local-privilege escalation (LPE) kernel vulnerability , which was introduced in the 4.15 kernel, in the Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP) subsystem.

entry.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
entry.summary:
World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #robotics #reinforcement-learning

entry.title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
entry.summary:
Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights

entry.title: RoughCut-Bench: A Benchmark for Automatic Video Rough-Cut with Large Vision-Language Models
entry.summary:
Video rough-cut is a core stage in media production workflows, organizing raw media materials into an initial video cut. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for video-related tasks, automatic rough-cut remains underexplored, without a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation or mature workflows for producing executable cut plans. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce RoughCut-Bench, which covers two practical settings: (1) a visually driven setting over video cases, covering highlight detection and selection, source-video ordering, and adherence to user requirements when provided; and (2) a speech-driven setting over automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, covering filler removal, expression deduplication, and low-value content trimming.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents

entry.title: UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
entry.summary:
Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #clean-tech #computer-vision

entry.title: StatePortal: Agentic Checkpoint Synthesis for Testing Deep States in Interactive Software
entry.summary:
Large language models have reduced the effort to generate code for interactive software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs). For such software, a key testing bottleneck is reaching a deep state, one that requires a long interaction history. The cost of reaching it recurs across commits, and the GUI automation that could amortize it assumes a DOM or accessibility tree that self-rendered engines do not expose.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #combinatorics #agents

entry.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
entry.summary:
We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents

entry.title: An Atiyah--Hirzebruch to Adams map and the hastened Adams spectral sequence for supercohomology
entry.summary:
We construct a map of filtered spectra inducing a map from the Atiyah--Hirzebruch spectral sequence (AHSS) to the Baker--Lazarev Adams spectral sequence of a $\mathit{ko}$-module $M$. Using this and a theorem of Bruner--Rognes, we construct a hastened Adams spectral sequence (HASS) for the Postnikov truncations of $\mathit{ko}$ and the connective Adams summand. Then, motivated by questions in quantum field theory, topological phases of matter, and tensor category theory, we apply the HASS to supercohomology, the cohomology theory $I_{\mathbb{C}^\times}(τ_{\le 2}\mathit{ko})$, and observe that in examples of interest it is easier to calculate with than either the AHSS or the usual Adams spectral sequence.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #topology #high-energy

entry.title: Cameron--Martin theorem for SLE welding measures. For $κ\in(0,4]$, we prove a Cameron--Martin theorem for the welding law induced by SLE$_κ$ loop measure.
entry.summary:
For $κ\in(0,4]$, we prove a Cameron--Martin theorem for the welding law induced by SLE$_κ$ loop measure. Under simultaneous left and right composition $h\mapsto\varphi\circ h\circψ^{-1}$, the transformed law is mutually absolutely continuous with respect to the original law exactly when both maps belong to the Weil--Petersson group, and is mutually singular otherwise. Thus the Weil--Petersson group is the quasi-invariance group of the welding law under composition on either side.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #probability-stats #logic

entry.title: Two almost sure upper bounds for sums of random multiplicative functions. Let $f,g$ be a squarefree and extended Rademacher random multiplicative functions, respectively.
entry.summary:
Let $f,g$ be a squarefree and extended Rademacher random multiplicative functions, respectively. We prove that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, almost surely $$\big|\sum_{n \le x}\frac{f(n)}{\sqrt{n}}\big| \ll (\log\log x)^{1/4+\varepsilon}, \qquad \big|\sum_{n\le x}g(n)\big|\ll\sqrt{x}(\log\log x)^{1/4+\varepsilon}.$$ We also show that almost surely, there exist arbitrarily large values of $x$ such that $\sum_{n \le x}\frac{f(n)}{\sqrt{n}} \gg (\log\log x)^{1/4+o(1)}$. We follow Caich and Durkan and Pearce-Crump by using a version of the Azuma--Hoeffding inequality for martingale difference sequences.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #probability-stats

entry.title: The Structural Number of Parties: An Electoral-Outcome-Independent Baseline for Comparing Party-System Scale
entry.summary:
How many parties can a country structurally sustain? Standard measures such as the effective number of parties (ENP) cannot answer this question. They are descriptive and post hoc: they summarize competition only after an election, and they depend on electoral returns that are often missing, interrupted, or unreliable in many developing democracies, particularly in Africa.

Source: arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) · Tags: #econometrics #macroeconomics #complex-systems

entry.title: Residual Allan Stability under Periodic Auxiliary Ramsey Sampling
entry.summary:
The timing of auxiliary Ramsey measurements can change the frequency stability associated with a drifting pulse shift at a fixed nominal Fisher-information rate for a constant shift. For periodic instantaneous observations of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck shift with causal prediction between updates, we derive the exact residual covariance averaged over the update cycle and the corresponding Allan variance at arbitrary averaging times. Relative to a continuous Kalman reference at the same information rate, periodic estimation increases the cycle-averaged estimation-error variance, reduces the short-time residual Allan variance, and increases its long-time value.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #optics-photonics

entry.title: From geometric curvature to effective backgrounds: a dictionary for Dirac fermions in one, two and three spatial dimensions
entry.summary:
Dirac equation on curved backgrounds can be rewritten as a flat-space equation in which geometry appears as a tensorial Fermi velocity together with a set of background fields. We derive this correspondence from a single Clifford-algebra identity and follow it through one, two, and three spatial dimensions. Once the spin connection is written in terms of Ricci rotation coefficients, only two contractions can occur.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #astrophysics #high-energy

entry.title: Time-Varying Medium from an Ensemble of Laser-Dressed Quantum Emitters
entry.summary:
We propose a minimal quantum-mechanical model of a frequency dispersive, time-modulated medium that explicitly incorporates the pumping mechanism. It consists of a homogeneous ensemble of quantum emitters dressed by a pump laser. We analyze their dispersive, time-varying response to a perturbative probe field by deriving the macroscopic polarizability of the ensemble, and then solving Maxwell's equations via the Floquet formalism.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #optics-photonics

entry.title: Shedding Light on Quantum Non-Classicality: Witnessing Wigner Negativity with Free Electrons
entry.summary:
Certifying quantum non-classicality like Wigner negativity typically demands full optical state tomography. This work introduces a noise-resilient framework for witnessing optical Wigner negativity using phase-resolved quantum photon-induced near-field electron microscopy (QPINEM). By mapping electron coherences directly to symmetrically ordered optical characteristic functions within a coupling-limited phase-space region, the protocol bypasses full optical reconstruction.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #optics-photonics #logic

entry.title: Computing $F$-Symbols from Modular Data
entry.summary:
We present a strategy for computing the $F$-symbols of unitary modular categories with a self-dual simple generator, starting from their modular data, which almost entirely avoids the non-linear solution of the pentagon equations. The algorithm climbs a ladder of braid group representations on successively more strands of the generator until enough $F$-symbols have been determined to propagate them to a complete solution. The strategy presented is successful in difficult cases through ranks 11 and 12, including $\operatorname{Z}(\mathrm{Haagerup}_3)$, and does not require the category to be multiplicity-free.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #high-energy #clean-tech

entry.title: Learning the Anyon Atlas
entry.summary:
We extend our previous search for the modular data of topological quantum field theories in 2+1 dimensions from 22 to 42 anyons, identifying 150,679 new modular data. We do so by adding to our algorithm three rejection gates, two of them based on logistic regression, that discard representations of $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ unlikely to yield modular data. We estimate that roughly 80% of the modular data between ranks 23 and 42 has been identified after closing under known constructions.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #high-energy #ml-theory

entry.title: MicroAssert: Microarchitecture-Aware Structured Assertion Generation for CPU Verification
entry.summary:
Automatic assertion generation reduces manual verification effort, yet existing approaches struggle to capture microarchitectural behaviors and cross-region interactions in CPUs. We present MicroAssert, a microarchitecture-aware framework that identifies functional regions directly from RTL and generates local and composite assertions through structured contracts and deterministic verification primitives. Coverage-guided feedback further improves verification completeness by progressively expanding proof-relevant RTL coverage.

Source: arXiv CS (PL, SE, DB, DC, DS) · Tags: #compilers #distributed-systems #computer-architecture #software-architecture

entry.title: PULSAR-V: I/O-Aware Post-Update Attestation for RISC-V
entry.summary:
Post-update attestation proves that a device installed the intended firmware, not that the image stayed protected until the report was signed. In a multi-master SoC, a master outside the attested processor can corrupt update-critical memory. In contrast, the firmware identity, lifecycle state, and the CPU's protection evidence remain byte-identical to a healthy device's.

Source: arXiv Systems & Architecture (cs.OS, cs.AR, cs.NI, cs.PF) · Tags: #computer-architecture #kernel-os #cryptography #semiconductors
